name: Hairy-fruit sedge
desc: Hairy-fruit sedge (Carex trichocarpa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex trichocarpa, the hairy-fruited sedge, is a species of Carex native to North America. It is listed as a "species of special concern" in Connecticut, the United States.
